headline: Rubio confirms 'talks of a meeting'
dek: After WSJ reported Putin proposed a Putin-Trump-Xi summit (APEC sidelines, Shenzhen Nov 18-19, no Zelenskyy), Monday reactions: Ukraine FM Andrii Sybiha (X, Oct 19): a US-Russia-China trilateral would 'only... encourage Putin to continue this war'; 'He is not a global leader; he is a war criminal.
sources: WSJ reporting (Oct 18) + FM Andrii Sybiha X statement (Oct 19) + Rubio press remarks Samarkand (Oct 19) + Kyiv Independent
fault_line: Yalta 2.0? Should three powers decide Ukraine’s fate without Kyiv — or is excluding Zelensky the only way to get a deal signed?

sections.what_happened: After WSJ reported Putin proposed a Putin-Trump-Xi summit (APEC sidelines, Shenzhen Nov 18-19, no Zelenskyy), Monday reactions: Ukraine FM Andrii Sybiha (X, Oct 19): a US-Russia-China trilateral would 'only... encourage Putin to continue this war'; 'He is not a global leader; he is a war criminal. And Russia is not a global power; it is a global problem.' Rubio (Samarkand): 'there's been talks of a meeting' — no detail. WSJ: Chinese officials told Russian diplomats they would not object if Trump agrees. Peskov: discussions happening, 'no clear understanding yet' on meeting or agenda. Senior US official: Trump has not agreed but could be receptive.
sections.what_verified: Reuters wire (Oct 19) confirming WSJ report + Peskov + US official quotes; Kyiv Independent (Oct 19) carrying Sybiha X statement verbatim; Straits Times, LiveMint, AsiaOne consistent. WSJ piece itself updated within the hour.
sections.what_disputed: Summit remains hypothetical: no agreement on meeting/agenda; Trump has not agreed; White House no comment. WSJ sourcing leans on 'people familiar' + one former Russian intel officer — primary confirmations only from Peskov/Sybiha/Rubio public remarks.
sections.why_matters: The war of the century may be settled by a photo with an empty chair. Putin wants Trump and Xi in Shenzhen, no Zelensky invited — Kyiv calls it a trap, Washington admits talks are real. TOTW: the bloc that decides this decides the next decade.
sections.context: Background: Putin-Trump-Xi trilateral summit — UPDATE (extends 1300-01): Monday reactions — Kyiv FM rejects on X; Rubio confirms 'talks of a meeting'; China won't object

totw_analysis: Our read: The war of the century may be settled by a photo with an empty chair. Putin wants Trump and Xi in Shenzhen, no Zelensky invited — Kyiv calls it a trap, Washington admits talks are real. TOTW: the bloc that decides this decides the next decade. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Yalta 2.0? Should three powers decide Ukraine’s fate without Kyiv — or is excluding Zelensky the only way to get a deal signed?
